text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O, who competed fiercely against Mejiro Ardan at the Japanese Derby, is hospitalized following an injury and temporarily withdraws from racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two promise to meet again on the turf one day, with Mejiro Ardan wishing to become a rival worthy of Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I share with her two branching options for future goals. One entails her racing against Yaeno Muteki again in the Kikuka Sho, the final race of the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other option is to have her compete in the decider of all medium-distance races, the autumn Tenno Sho. Not only will it feature senior-year participants, it'll also put her up against top racers like Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While either choice will be an uphill battle for Mejiro Ardan, it would also be an opportunity for growth. As her trainer, the decision I come to is…
choice_data_list: To enter the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The goal race is now the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having decided on the path leading to the Kikuka Sho, we vow to forge ahead toward our next battle with fresh determination!
